question: If “at the moment the finger is cut off, the finger that was cut off becomes the target of the ‘Reaper’”, then instead of directly pressing the torn finger to another finger, hardening the outer surface using plaster like is used for a broken bone, sort of a treatment would probably lead to gangrene, but it would have an effect!
answer: It would likely cause gangrene, but it would have an effect. If your fingertip was cut and you wrapped it in cellophane tape for the rest of your life, you wouldn’t die of blood loss, at least.
